bash -lc 'cd /home/user/ws5-tar; python3 tests/tar.py > docs/evidence/tar/native-full-r3.log 2>&1; status=$?; tail -16 docs/evidence/tar/native-full-r3.log; exit $status'

bash -lc 'cd /home/user/ws5-tar; python3 tests/tar.py --quick > docs/evidence/tar/native-quick-r3-limit-fixed.log 2>&1; status=$?; tail -12 docs/evidence/tar/native-quick-r3-limit-fixed.log; exit $status'

bash -lc 'cd /home/user/ws5-tar; python3 tests/tar.py --quick > docs/evidence/tar/native-quick-r3-limit-red.log 2>&1; status=$?; tail -12 docs/evidence/tar/native-quick-r3-limit-red.log; exit $status'

bash -lc 'set -e; tar -xzf /home/user/ws5-tar-provider-tools.tar.gz -C /home/user/ws5-tar; tar -xzf /home/user/ws5-tar-r3-source.tar.gz -C /home/user/ws5-tar; cd /home/user/ws5-tar; python3 tests/tar.py --quick > docs/evidence/tar/native-quick-r3.log 2>&1; cat docs/evidence/tar/native-quick-r3.log'

sh -lc 'date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%NZ > docs/evidence/tar/native-prestart-r3.utc; ps -eo pid,ppid,etimes,comm,args --sort=pid > docs/evidence/tar/native-processes-before-r3.txt; cat docs/evidence/tar/native-prestart-r3.utc'
